I see from the sonarless-mcp documentation that tokens should never be passed through chat or commands. Instead, please run this command in your terminal — it will prompt you for the token interactively:

```bash
sonarless-mcp remote add ci --url https://sonar.acme.example
```

When prompted, enter your token: `<token>`

This keeps the token out of command history and chat logs. Once added, you can verify it with:

```bash
sonarless-mcp remote list
```
